`cargo test -p elephc --doc` was red on
`src/codegen_support/runtime/exceptions/trace_buffer.rs` line 21: the measured rendering of php's
frame arguments is written as an indented block, and rustdoc compiles an indented block inside a
doc comment as Rust. Fencing it as ```text states what it is and takes it out of the doctest.

The gate is red on all three architectures in CI and green in every local run that does not
include `--doc`, which is why it survived.
